Brief Description: Direct income support to farmers
Detailed Description: PM-KISAN provides income support of Rs 6000 per year to all landholding farmer families across India. The amount is paid in three equal installments of Rs 2000 directly to bank accounts via DBT.
Benefits: Rs 6000 per year in 3 installments of Rs 2000 each
Eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with cultivable land; families with combined landholding up to 2 hectares; age 18-60
Application Process: Register at nearest CSC or PM-KISAN portal with Aadhaar and land records
Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Department: Department of Agriculture Cooperation and Farmers Welfare

Brief Description: Crop insurance for farmers against natural calamities
Detailed Description: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana provides financial support to farmers suffering crop loss due to unforeseen events like natural calamities pests and diseases. Premium rates are 2% for Kharif and 1.5% for Rabi crops.
Benefits: Insurance coverage for crop loss due to natural calamities; low premium rates; settlement through remote sensing and technology
Eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas; age 18-70
Application Process: Apply at nearest bank branch or CSC during crop season with land records and bank details
Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Department: Department of Agriculture Cooperation and Farmers Welfare

Brief Description: Savings scheme for girl child education and marriage
Detailed Description: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is a government savings scheme for the girl child providing attractive interest rate currently 8.2% per annum. Account can be opened in post offices and authorized banks.
Benefits: High interest rate 8.2% pa; tax benefits under 80C; partial withdrawal allowed after girl turns 18 for education
Eligibility: Parents or guardians of girl child below 10 years of age; Indian residents; one account per girl child; maximum 2 accounts per family
Application Process: Open account at nearest post office or authorized bank with birth certificate of girl child and parent identity proof

Brief Description: Micro loans for non-farm small enterprises
Detailed Description: PMMY provides loans up to Rs 10 lakh to non-corporate non-farm small micro enterprises. Three categories: Shishu up to Rs 50000; Kishor Rs 50001-5 lakh; Tarun Rs 5 lakh-10 lakh.
Benefits: Collateral-free loans up to Rs 10 lakh; low interest rates; three loan tiers for different business stages
Eligibility: Small business owners; micro entrepreneurs; women entrepreneurs; SC/ST entrepreneurs; non-corporate non-farm businesses
Application Process: Apply at nearest bank NBFC MFI with business plan and identity documents
Implementing Agency: MUDRA Bank and partner lending institutions

Brief Description: Scheme to save and educate the girl child
Detailed Description: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao aims to address the declining Child Sex Ratio and promote welfare and education of the girl child. Implemented across 640 districts in India with multi-sectoral interventions.
Benefits: Awareness campaigns; educational support for girl child; medical support; legal protection
Eligibility: Girl child; families with girl children; pregnant women; women in reproductive age group
Application Process: Contact nearest Anganwadi center or district administration for support services
Ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Department: Department of Women and Child Development

Brief Description: Fostering innovation and entrepreneurship in India
Detailed Description: AIM is a flagship initiative of NITI Aayog to promote innovation and entrepreneurship across India. Atal Tinkering Labs ATLs are established in schools to cultivate innovative mindset. Atal Incubation Centres AIC support startups.
Benefits: Funding for Tinkering Labs up to Rs 20 lakh; incubation support; mentorship; grants up to Rs 10 crore for AICs
Eligibility: Students aged 10-18 for ATLs; startups and entrepreneurs for AICs; schools for establishing ATLs
Application Process: Apply online at AIM portal with required documents and proposals

Brief Description: Credit-linked subsidy for micro enterprises
Detailed Description: PMEGP provides credit-linked subsidy for setting up micro enterprises in non-farm sector to generate employment opportunities. Subsidy 15-35% of project cost depending on area and category.
Benefits: Subsidy 15-35% of project cost; loans up to Rs 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs 20 lakh for service sector
Eligibility: Individual entrepreneurs above 18 years; SC/ST OBC women ex-servicemen minorities persons with disability; minimum 8th pass for projects above Rs 10 lakh
Application Process: Apply at KVIC DIC or Khadi Board offices with project report and identity documents

Brief Description: Health insurance coverage for poor families
Detailed Description: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana provides health coverage of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization. Covers 1949 medical procedures at empaneled hospitals.
Benefits: Health coverage up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year; cashless treatment at empaneled hospitals; covers pre and post hospitalization
Eligibility: Families identified in SECC 2011 database; BPL families; approximately 10.74 crore vulnerable families
Application Process: Check eligibility at nearest CSC or Ayushman Bharat portal; get Ayushman card
Ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Implementing Agency: National Health Authority and State Health Agencies

Brief Description: Central scholarship platform for students
Detailed Description: National Scholarship Portal is a one-stop platform for students to apply for various central and state government scholarships. Covers pre-matric post-matric and merit-cum-means scholarships for SC ST OBC minorities and general students.
Benefits: Financial assistance for education; multiple scholarships on single platform; direct bank transfer
Eligibility: Students from Class 1 to PhD level; SC ST OBC EWS minority students; income criteria vary by scholarship; age varies 5-35
Application Process: Register on NSP portal with Aadhaar academic documents and bank account details

Brief Description: Affordable housing for urban poor
Detailed Description: PMAY-U aims to provide housing for all in urban areas by 2022. Provides credit-linked subsidy on home loans for EWS LIG and MIG categories. Interest subsidy up to 6.5% on home loans.
Benefits: Credit linked interest subsidy 3-6.5%; affordable housing units; subsidy up to Rs 2.67 lakh
Eligibility: EWS families with income up to Rs 3 lakh; LIG with income Rs 3-6 lakh; MIG-I Rs 6-12 lakh; MIG-II Rs 12-18 lakh; SC/ST minorities women preferred
Application Process: Apply at bank or housing finance company with income proof Aadhaar and property documents
Ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Implementing Agency: State Governments ULBs and Housing Agencies

Brief Description: Free skill training and certification for youth
Detailed Description: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana provides free short-term skill training to Indian youth. Trainees receive monetary rewards for successful completion and certification recognized by industry.
Benefits: Free skill training; certification; monetary reward Rs 8000 for assessment and certification; placement support
Eligibility: Indian citizens aged 15-45; school dropouts; unemployed youth; priority to SC/ST OBC minorities women
Application Process: Register at nearest PMKVY Training Centre or online portal with Aadhaar and educational certificates
Ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

Brief Description: Bank loans for SC ST and women entrepreneurs
Detailed Description: Stand Up India facilitates bank loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.
Benefits: Loans Rs 10 lakh to 1 crore; composite loan covering 75% of project cost; 7 years repayment period
Eligibility: SC/ST entrepreneurs; women entrepreneurs; above 18 years; for greenfield projects only; borrower should not be in default
Application Process: Apply at nearest bank branch or Stand Up India portal with business plan and identity documents
Implementing Agency: SIDBI NABARD and Scheduled Commercial Banks

Brief Description: Award for contribution to Kannada culture and Karnataka
Detailed Description: Karnataka Rajyotsava Award is given on November 1 every year to individuals who have made significant contributions to the Kannada language culture and overall development of Karnataka state.
Benefits: Cash award and citation; recognition for contribution to Karnataka; felicitation at state level ceremony
Eligibility: Karnataka residents; individuals with significant contribution to Kannada language art culture social service; no age bar
Application Process: Submit nomination to Department of Kannada and Culture Karnataka Government with supporting documents
Implementing Agency: Department of Kannada and Culture Karnataka

Scheme Name: Maharashtra Chief Ministers Solar Agriculture Pump Scheme
Brief Description: Subsidized solar pumps for farmers in Maharashtra
Detailed Description: Maharashtra government provides solar agriculture pumps to farmers who do not have electricity connection or have unstable electricity supply. Subsidy up to 95% for SC/ST farmers and 90% for general farmers.
Benefits: Subsidized solar pump up to 90-95%; reduced electricity bills; reliable irrigation; 3 HP and 5 HP pumps available
Eligibility: Farmers in Maharashtra; those without electricity connection or with unstable supply; priority to SC/ST and small farmers; land ownership required
Application Process: Apply at nearest Agriculture Department office in Maharashtra with land documents and identity proof

Scheme Name: Tamil Nadu Chief Ministers Breakfast Scheme
Brief Description: Free breakfast for government school students in Tamil Nadu
Detailed Description: Tamil Nadu government provides free nutritious breakfast to students of Classes 1-5 in all government schools. The scheme aims to improve nutrition levels attendance and learning outcomes among school children.
Benefits: Free nutritious breakfast daily; improved nutrition; better attendance and learning outcomes
Eligibility: Students of Classes 1 to 5 in government schools in Tamil Nadu; all students regardless of caste or economic background
Application Process: Automatic enrollment for all students in Tamil Nadu government schools; no separate application needed

Brief Description: Monthly financial assistance to women in Delhi
Detailed Description: Delhi government provides monthly financial assistance of Rs 1000 to women residents of Delhi above 18 years of age. The scheme aims to provide financial security and empowerment to women.
Benefits: Rs 1000 per month directly to bank account; financial empowerment; no condition on spending
Eligibility: Women residents of Delhi; aged 18 and above; Delhi voter ID mandatory; annual income below Rs 3 lakh; no government job or pension
Application Process: Register at nearest camp site with voter ID Aadhaar bank account and income certificate
Department: Department of Women and Child Development Delhi
Implementing Agency: Women and Child Development Department Delhi

Brief Description: Scholarship for meritorious students from economically weaker sections
Detailed Description: NMMSS provides scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their dropout at Class 8 and encourage them to continue up to Class 12. Scholarship of Rs 12000 per year.
Benefits: Rs 12000 per year (Rs 1000 per month); continued up to Class 12; direct bank transfer
Eligibility: Students of Class 9 to 12; passed Class 8 with minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST); family income below Rs 3.5 lakh; studying in government schools
Application Process: Apply through state government portal or school principal with Class 8 marksheet and income certificate
Department: Department of School Education and Literacy

Brief Description: Universal banking access for unbanked population
Detailed Description: PMJDY is a national mission for financial inclusion ensuring access to financial services like banking savings deposit accounts remittance credit insurance and pension in an affordable manner.
Benefits: Zero balance bank account; RuPay debit card; accidental insurance Rs 2 lakh; overdraft up to Rs 10000; life insurance Rs 30000
Eligibility: Any Indian citizen above 10 years without a bank account; no minimum balance requirement; Aadhaar or any government ID sufficient
Application Process: Visit nearest bank branch or Business Correspondent with Aadhaar or any government ID

Brief Description: Micro credit for street vendors post COVID-19
Detailed Description: PM SVANidhi provides affordable working capital loans to street vendors to resume their livelihoods adversely affected by COVID-19 pandemic. First loan Rs 10000; second Rs 20000; third Rs 50000.
Benefits: Collateral-free loans Rs 10000-50000; interest subsidy 7%; digital transaction incentive up to Rs 1200 per year; credit score building
Eligibility: Street vendors; urban local body certified vendors; vendors with Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation; any gender
Application Process: Apply at nearest bank MFI or through PM SVANidhi mobile app with vendor certificate and bank account
Ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Implementing Agency: Urban Local Bodies and Lending Institutions

Brief Description: Improving healthcare in rural India
Detailed Description: NRHM aims to provide accessible affordable and quality health care to the rural population especially the vulnerable groups. Provides free healthcare services at PHCs CHCs district hospitals and community health workers.
Benefits: Free healthcare at public health facilities; free medicines; ASHA workers for health support; free diagnostics
Eligibility: Rural population; BPL families; SC/ST communities; pregnant women; children below 5; no age or income bar for basic services
Application Process: Visit nearest PHC CHC or district hospital; ASHA worker will guide for specific services and schemes
Ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Implementing Agency: State Health Societies and District Health Societies
